title: endurain importer dedupe via postgres
objective: Give the importer a working answer to 'does Endurain already hold this run?', now that the HTTP route cannot provide one: API keys are upload-only and the activities read endpoint is JWT-only, so the existing check always returned None and every pass relied on the local ledger alone.
acceptance_criteria: A run Endurain already holds is skipped even when the local ledger is empty, and the activity count does not grow.
The same run IS imported when the fallback is disabled, proving the check is what blocks it.
A dead or renamed container yields None (ledger fallback), while a user with no activities yields an empty list; the two are never conflated.
The journal distinguishes which backend answered, so a DB-sourced pass is not mistaken for a ledger-only one.
Verified in the real systemd unit, not only from an interactive shell.
100% branch coverage on the new and changed modules, with no lint suppressions added.
No test touches the real postgres container.
out_of_scope: Removing or replacing the HTTP lookup - it stays first in the chain so the supported path resumes working by itself if Endurain widens the API-key scope allow-list.
Exposing a postgres host port or adding a database driver dependency.
Patching Endurain's own source or forging scopes in users_api_keys to work around the upload-only allow-list.
verifier: pre-commit + python_pkg/endurain_import/tests + a real systemctl --user run with journal inspection
